promises.label: FY27 revenue growth above 25%
promises.quote: we are hopeful to grow in the current year by more than 25% and in next 3 to 4 years by 20% CAGR
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: FY27 EBITDA margin close to 11%
promises.quote: our guidance is still maintaining that we will be growing at a 25%-plus growth rate and our EBITDA margin will be close to 11%
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Sanand Phase 2 EHV/HT commercial production by end March 2027
promises.quote: The planned commercial production of Phase 2 of extra high-voltage cable and HT cable in Sanand will commence by end of March '27
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Annual capex ~₹600 crore for next 3-4 years
promises.quote: Company is expected to incur capital expenditure of approximately INR 600 crores annually for next 3 to 4 years
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: 20% CAGR over next 3-4 years
promises.quote: we will grow at a 20% CAGR in future
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Sanand peak utilization FY28-29
promises.quote: FY 28-'29. Sir, that guidance is still intact. So in FY 28, '29, you will see the peak revenue from there
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Sanand adds ₹1,500-1,700 crore EHV capacity
promises.quote: new capacity additional will be more than INR 1,500 crores to INR 1,700 crores in terms of value
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: EPC losses ₹5-7 crore next 1-2 quarters
promises.quote: in next 1 or 2 quarters, the INR 5 crores to INR 7 crores loss will be there because we are almost closing down the EPC
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

reported.label: Q2 net sales ₹3,776 crore, +38.52%
reported.quote: net sales in Q2 of FY27 is INR 3,776 crores. So we have achieved a growth by 38.52%

reported.label: Q2 EBITDA ₹401 crore, +28.69%
reported.quote: EBITDA in this quarter is INR 401crores against INR311 crores last year... The growth in EBITDA is 28.69%

reported.label: Q2 PAT ₹262.45 crore, +28.96%
reported.quote: Profit after tax this quarter is INR262.45 crores against INR203.51 crores in last year. Growth in the PAT is 28.96%

reported.label: Q2 operating margin 9.97%
reported.quote: operating margin is almost at par at 9.97% against 9.88% previous year same period

reported.label: H1 net sales ₹6,961 crore, ~31% growth
reported.quote: For first half of 6 months in FY 27, net sales achieved is INR 6,961 crores. So the growth in H1 is almost 31%

reported.label: Order book: W&C ₹4,927 crore, EPC ₹258 crore
reported.quote: Total order book at the moment in Wire and Cable segment is INR 4,927 crores, EPC INR 258 crores

reported.label: H1 capex ₹402 crore, Sanand ₹333 crore
reported.quote: During H1 FY '26-'27, company has incurred a capital expenditure payment of INR 402 crores, out of which Sanand capex is INR 333 crores
